claim_ceiling: Metadata/source audit only. No code execution, data acquisition or metric reproduction has occurred.

scenarios.name: No explicit software licence is visible
scenarios.conditions: Default branch has no LICENSE file.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Obtain a software licence or written permission before reuse.

scenarios.name: External dataset link has no visible rights terms
scenarios.conditions: README links a Baidu download but no dataset licence is stated.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Confirm rights before download or derivative use.

scenarios.name: README describes absent package/scripts/config files
scenarios.conditions: Observed default-branch tree lacks the documented layout and scripts.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reconcile source inventory before claiming installability.

scenarios.name: End-to-end training code is absent
scenarios.conditions: Models and split lists exist but no visible train scripts or objective.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Obtain exact training configuration.

scenarios.name: Vehicle signal extraction file is a stub
scenarios.conditions: File contains only a docstring.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not claim complete classifier pipeline.

scenarios.name: Classifier metric module is a stub
scenarios.conditions: File contains only a docstring.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Obtain exact evaluation implementation.

scenarios.name: Superlet import falls back to developer path
scenarios.conditions: superletcx is absent and an absolute developer path is attempted.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Pin portable dependency source, version and licence.

scenarios.name: Main path discards computed denoised array
scenarios.conditions: run_das_pcse passes raw data to frontend after denoised data is computed.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Resolve author-exact pipeline dataflow.

scenarios.name: Training split includes label -1
scenarios.conditions: 2,786 rows are unlabeled in training; no -1 rows in validation.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Clarify semisupervised/unlabeled treatment and loss.

scenarios.name: Train and validation sample paths overlap
scenarios.conditions: Any common path appears in both lists.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject reproduction until split is reconciled.

scenarios.name: Physical-event/session grouping is missing
scenarios.conditions: File paths are disjoint but group identity is unavailable.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not claim event/site-independent validation.

scenarios.name: Five-output classifier and 1–4/-1 labels lack visible mapping
scenarios.conditions: No public train entry point explains class remapping/ignore handling.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Obtain label dictionary and loss-target convention.

scenarios.name: Files in a stacked run have mixed acquisition parameters
scenarios.conditions: Sample rate, channel count, spatial interval or clock metadata differ.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject stack or split into homogeneous profiles.

scenarios.name: Filename timestamp cannot be parsed
scenarios.conditions: Sorter assigns datetime.min to the invalid name.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Use authoritative timestamps or preserve unknown ordering.

scenarios.name: Spatial selection contains no complete averaging block
scenarios.conditions: Selected interval yields zero samples/channels.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject empty window and preserve channel-distance mapping.

scenarios.name: Per-sample min-max removes absolute amplitude
scenarios.conditions: Classifier may rely on physical amplitude cues.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare normalized, calibrated and raw ablations.

scenarios.name: No dependency/environment lock is present
scenarios.conditions: No pyproject or requirements file in observed tree.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Record exact runtime/dependency versions.

scenarios.name: Author metric reproduction under exact setup
scenarios.conditions: Lawful data, complete source and split/config are available.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reproduce IoU/accuracy/latency and confusion matrix.

scenarios.name: New road/site held out for transfer testing
scenarios.conditions: Whole site/session and event groups are withheld.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report transfer, uncertainty and abstention.

scenarios.name: Denoiser removes a short event while raising SNR
scenarios.conditions: Independent truth shows critical transient/timing loss.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Fail preservation gate despite SNR improvement.

scenarios.name: Small sample acquired under explicit permission
scenarios.conditions: Rights and purpose allow the exact fixture use.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Record hash, bytes, metadata and scope.

scenarios.name: New implementation precedes faithful reproduction
scenarios.conditions: Reference dependency/training behavior is not yet pinned.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Call it a candidate method, not reproduction.

global_controls: Public source visibility does not establish software or dataset licence.
Paper results remain attached to the authors' own data and exact evaluation setup.
Preprocessing dataflow is checked from source code, not inferred from README wording.
Unlabeled rows require a documented training objective and policy.
Disjoint filenames do not establish physical-event/session/site independence.
Source data remain immutable and are digested after authorized acquisition.
Every preprocessing operation carries a method/version/parameter record.
Traffic classification and trajectory metrics are not utility-fault POD or route geolocation.
Faithful reproduction requires author-exact behavior and complete source/configuration.
Any implementation built before baseline reproduction is labelled a separate candidate method.
